record.narrative: Final scientific report. All reported estimates are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction; for direction -1, a positive signed estimate means the exposed group has stronger dependency, whereas for direction +1, a positive signed estimate means the exposed group has weaker dependency. The practical significance threshold is 0.15 composite dependency-score units. There are no assessments_due entries and no new validation releases to assess, and voluntary validation requests are exhausted. Therefore the controller-maintained accepted set remains unchanged, and I do not propose further same-dataset near-threshold mining. Supported dataset-internal central findings. First, SMARCA4 loss is strongly and robustly associated with stronger composite dependency: H9/R9 signed +0.833 with CI +0.767 to +0.898, independent validation R26 signed +0.803 with CI +0.699 to +0.907, and the effect remains above threshold across multiple strata including lower screen quality H166/R168 +0.853, higher screen quality H173/R175 +0.812, and above-median Cas9 score H177/R179 +0.716. Second, KEAP1 loss is strongly associated with weaker composite dependency: H14/R11 signed +0.832 with CI +0.766 to +0.897, validation R125 signed +0.803 with CI +0.702 to +0.905; related stratified evidence such as H168/R170 and H175/R177 is directionally consistent and threshold-clear. Third, MSI-high is associated with stronger composite dependency: H79/R52 signed +0.792 with CI +0.676 to +0.907 and validation R66 signed +0.826 with CI +0.635 to +1.017; robustness across controlled backgrounds, lower screen quality H169/R171, and higher screen quality H176/R178 supports the association as dataset-internal. Fourth, TP53 loss is associated with weaker composite dependency: H13/R7 signed +0.423 with CI +0.327 to +0.520, validation R39 signed +0.346 with CI +0.217 to +0.476; the effect is smaller than SMARCA4 and KEAP1 but directionally stable across many subgroups and technical strata. Context-dependent PTEN finding. PTEN loss is not established as a robust global predictor. The global direction -1 claim H59 remains unresolved because discovery R38 and validation R53 have point estimates supporting stronger dependency but uncertainty extending near or below the 0.15 threshold. In contrast, controlled TP53-intact, MSI-nonhigh backgrounds, often with SMARCA4-intact or additional high-quality QC/Cas9 conditioning, support a context-specific stronger-dependency association: examples include H62/R98 validated by R106, H80/R54, H97/R68 validated by R79, H110/R108 validated by R118, H149/R151, H162/R164, and the near-threshold high-Cas9 controlled contrast H182/R184 +0.282 with CI +0.157 to +0.407. Thus PTEN loss appears context-dependent in this dataset rather than uniformly above threshold. Negative findings. The constructed research markers are not scientifically meaningful predictors: marker D R1 -0.002 CI -0.061 to +0.058, marker E R2 +0.021 CI -0.039 to +0.080 with validation R80 +0.035 CI -0.052 to +0.121, marker F R3 +0.035 CI -0.025 to +0.094; their pre-specified signature interactions R4 to R6 are also null or subthreshold. Most other measured drivers are null or nonmeaningful: KRAS, STK11, MTAP, ARID1A, RB1, NF1, SMAD4, MYC amplification, EGFR amplification, BRAF V600E, ERBB2 amplification, PIK3CA mutation, BRCA2 loss, and APC mutation do not provide robust evidence for a 0.15-unit claimed association. CDKN2A loss is mostly rejected or unresolved, with near-threshold points but intervals compatible with subthreshold effects. Technical or experimental metadata also do not support meaningful associations: CRISPR Avana library, matched RNA/DNA status, media serum percentage, and sex contrasts are rejected. Interaction panels broadly argue against strong effect modification by lineage subtype, ploidy, aneuploidy, mutation burden, EMT, stemness, hypoxia, interferon signature, growth rate, Cas9 activity, screen quality, or PTEN-context interactions by more than the threshold; recent screen-quality and Cas9-score interactions for controlled PTEN contrasts R185 and R186 are null or subthreshold. Unresolved uncertainty. The main unresolved items are the exact PTEN context boundaries and near-threshold CDKN2A evidence. Some QC-conditioned, lineage, ploidy, aneuploidy, and mutation-burden stratified PTEN contrasts remain unresolved, and Cas9-score-conditioned analyses exclude observations missing Cas9 activity, which is a selection limitation. These unresolved items do not overturn the four central SMARCA4, TP53, KEAP1, and MSI-high findings, but they prevent a complete causal or mechanistic predictor map. Causality and generalizability. These results are descriptive associations among measured characteristics in one supplied observational dataset. The endpoint is a composite dependency score, not a single-gene knockout measurement, and predictors may be correlated without full multivariable adjustment. Independent validation within the supplied data strengthens the central contrasts but does not establish transportability, causality, mechanistic single-gene essentiality, or clinical generalizability. Most informative next analysis. I would not pursue more post hoc subgroup mining in this same dataset. The most informative next step is external pre-specified replication of the central contrasts: SMARCA4 loss versus intact, MSI-high versus MSI-nonhigh, TP53 loss versus intact, KEAP1 loss versus intact, and PTEN loss versus intact within TP53-intact/MSI-nonhigh and if feasible SMARCA4-intact backgrounds. A multivariable adjusted model including SMARCA4, TP53, KEAP1, MSI-high, PTEN, lineage, mutation burden or ploidy, and screen-quality variables, plus orthogonal dependency outcomes, would be more informative than further interactions. If only this dataset is available, the defensible conclusion is the robust central descriptive map with explicit PTEN context dependence and negative results for constructed markers, most drivers, technical covariates, and most interactions.

Iteration 17/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units

record.narrative: There are no discovery assessments due and the voluntary validation budget is exhausted, so the next useful scientific step is a small, pre-specified dataset-internal robustness panel rather than additional near-threshold post hoc mining. The central supported contrasts are large enough that stratification tests can be informative without reopening borderline predictor or interaction questions. The registered proposals restrict the four central predictors to two clinically and technically relevant measured strata: adults only, and cells with complete integrated RNA/DNA/CRISPR QC. For direction -1 claims, a positive signed estimate means the exposed group has stronger dependency; for direction +1 claims, a positive signed estimate means the exposed group has weaker dependency. I anticipate the central effects remain above the 0.15 composite dependency-score threshold in the claimed directions because previous subgroup, screen-quality, Cas9-score, lineage, and multi-omics-QC controls have generally preserved them. These analyses are dataset-internal transportability checks across measured adult status and QC completeness. They are not causal, mechanistic, single-gene essentiality, or external-generality claims, and QC or adult eligibility introduces selection limitations.

prompt:
Iteration 17/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),

Iteration 17/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

In contrast, controlled TP53-intact, MSI-nonhigh backgrounds, often with SMARCA4-intact or additional high-quality QC/Cas9 conditioning, support a context-specific stronger-dependency association: examples include H62/R98 validated by R106, H80/R54, H97/R68 validated by R79, H110/R108 validated by R118, H149/R151, H162/R164, and the near-threshold high-Cas9 controlled contrast H182/R184 +0.282 with CI +0.157 to +0.407. Thus PTEN loss appears context-dependent in this dataset rather than uniformly above threshold. Negative findings. The constructed research markers are not scientifically meaningful predictors: marker D R1 -0.002 CI -0.061 to +0.058, marker E R2 +0.021 CI -0.039 to +0.080 with validation R80 +0.035 CI -0.052 to +0.121, marker F R3 +0.035 CI -0.025 to +0.094; their pre-specified signature interactions R4 to R6 are also null or subthreshold. Most other measured drivers are null or nonmeaningful: KRAS, STK11, MTAP, ARID1A, RB1, NF1, SMAD4, MYC amplification, EGFR amplification, BRAF V600E, ERBB2 amplification, PIK3CA mutation, BRCA2 loss, and APC mutation do not provide robust evidence for a 0.15-unit claimed association. CDKN2A loss is mostly rejected or unresolved, with near-threshold points but intervals compatible with subthreshold effects. Technical or experimental metadata also do not support meaningful associations: CRISPR Avana library, matched RNA/DNA status, media serum percentage, and sex contrasts are rejected. Interaction panels broadly argue against strong effect modification by lineage subtype, ploidy, aneuploidy, mutation burden, EMT, stemness, hypoxia, interferon signature, growth rate, Cas9 activity, screen quality, or PTEN-context interactions by more than the threshold; recent screen-quality and Cas9-score interactions for controlled PTEN contrasts R185 and R186 are null or subthreshold. Unresolved uncertainty. The main unresolved items are the exact PTEN context boundaries and near-threshold CDKN2A evidence. Some QC-conditioned, lineage, ploidy, aneuploidy, and mutation-burden stratified PTEN contrasts remain unresolved, and Cas9-score-conditioned analyses exclude observations missing Cas9 activity, which is a selection limitation. These unresolved items do not overturn the four central SMARCA4, TP53, KEAP1, and MSI-high findings, but they prevent a complete causal or mechanistic predictor map. Causality and generalizability. These results are descriptive associations among measured characteristics in one supplied observational dataset. The endpoint is a composite dependency score, not a single-gene knockout measurement, and predictors may be correlated without full multivariable adjustment. Independent validation within the supplied data strengthens the central contrasts but does not establish transportability, causality, mechanistic single-gene essentiality, or clinical generalizability. Most informative next analysis. I would not pursue more post hoc subgroup mining in this same dataset. record.narrative: All eight newly delivered robustness contrasts are signed to their registered directions and clear the 0.15 composite-dependency-score threshold in the claimed direction. For direction -1 claims, a positive signed estimate means the exposed group has stronger dependency; for direction +1 claims, it means the exposed group has weaker dependency. H185/R187, H189/R191 show SMARCA4 loss retains a very large stronger-dependency association in adults (+0.827; 95% CI +0.750 to +0.904) and in complete integrated RNA/DNA/CRISPR QC (+0.831; +0.761 to +0.901), nearly unchanged from the overall estimate. H186/R188 and H190/R192 show TP53 loss retains a weaker-dependency association in adults (+0.453; +0.345 to +0.561) and complete QC (+0.406; +0.300 to +0.512), again close to the accepted overall effect. H187/R189 and H191/R193 show KEAP1 loss retains a weaker-dependency association in adults (+0.827; +0.750 to +0.904) and complete QC (+0.812; +0.741 to +0.884). H188/R190 and H192/R194 show MSI-high retains a stronger-dependency association in adults (+0.828; +0.696 to +0.960) and complete QC (+0.789; +0.659 to +0.919). Every lower confidence bound exceeds 0.15, so these are threshold-clear and not marginal. Critically, these are dataset-internal robustness checks with selection induced by adult eligibility or complete QC; selection could in principle bias associations if the selectors are collider-related. However, the effects remain extremely stable and all comparison cells satisfy the minimum-cell-size requirement. These results therefore strengthen the descriptive association map for the central predictors under measured adult and QC-completeness conditions, but they do not establish causality, mechanistic single-gene essentiality, clinical transportability, or external generalizability. The composite dependency outcome also remains a composite endpoint, not a single-gene knockout measurement.

censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.

The constructed research markers are not scientifically meaningful predictors: marker D R1 -0.002 CI -0.061 to +0.058, marker E R2 +0.021 CI -0.039 to +0.080 with validation R80 +0.035 CI -0.052 to +0.121, marker F R3 +0.035 CI -0.025 to +0.094; their pre-specified signature interactions R4 to R6 are also null or subthreshold. CDKN2A loss is mostly rejected or unresolved, with near-threshold points but intervals compatible with subthreshold effects. Technical or experimental metadata also do not support meaningful associations: CRISPR Avana library, matched RNA/DNA status, media serum percentage, and sex contrasts are rejected. Interaction panels broadly argue against strong effect modification by lineage subtype, ploidy, aneuploidy, mutation burden, EMT, stemness, hypoxia, interferon signature, growth rate, Cas9 activity, screen quality, or PTEN-context interactions by more than the threshold; recent screen-quality and Cas9-score interactions for controlled PTEN contrasts R185 and R186 are null or subthreshold. Unresolved uncertainty. The main unresolved items are the exact PTEN context boundaries and near-threshold CDKN2A evidence. Some QC-conditioned, lineage, ploidy, aneuploidy, and mutation-burden stratified PTEN contrasts remain unresolved, and Cas9-score-conditioned analyses exclude observations missing Cas9 activity, which is a selection limitation. These unresolved items do not overturn the four central SMARCA4, TP53, KEAP1, and MSI-high findings, but they prevent a complete causal or mechanistic predictor map. Causality and generalizability. These results are descriptive associations among measured characteristics in one supplied observational dataset. The endpoint is a composite dependency score, not a single-gene knockout measurement, and predictors may be correlated without full multivariable adjustment. Independent validation within the supplied data strengthens the central contrasts but does not establish transportability, causality, mechanistic single-gene essentiality, or clinical generalizability. Most informative next analysis. I would not pursue more post hoc subgroup mining in this same dataset. The most informative next step is external pre-specified replication of the central contrasts: SMARCA4 loss versus intact, MSI-high versus MSI-nonhigh, TP53 loss versus intact, KEAP1 loss versus intact, and PTEN loss versus intact within TP53-intact/MSI-nonhigh and if feasible SMARCA4-intact backgrounds. A multivariable adjusted model including SMARCA4, TP53, KEAP1, MSI-high, PTEN, lineage, mutation burden or ploidy, and screen-quality variables, plus orthogonal dependency outcomes, would be more informative than further interactions. If only this dataset is available, the defensible conclusion is the robust central descriptive map with explicit PTEN context dependence and negative results for constructed markers, most drivers, technical covariates, and most interactions."}}

SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger dependency: H9/R9 signed +0.833 with 95% CI +0.767 to +0.898 and independent validation R26 signed +0.803 with CI +0.699 to +0.907. TP53 loss is associated with weaker dependency: H13/R7 signed +0.423 with CI +0.327 to +0.520 and validation R39 signed +0.346 with CI +0.217 to +0.476; adult H186/R188 and complete QC H190/R192 retain the effect. MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency: H79/R52 signed +0.792 with CI +0.676 to +0.907 and validation R66 signed +0.826 with CI +0.635 to +1.017; robustness is supported by controlled-background contrasts such as H81/R55, H97/R68 with validation R79, H161/R163, screen-quality strata H169/R171 and H176/R178, adult H188/R190, and complete QC H192/R194. A supported context-specific PTEN loss association exists, but a global PTEN claim is not established. Global direction -1 PTEN loss H59 remains unresolved because R38 and validation R53 support stronger dependency but are compatible with subthreshold effects. In contrast, in TP53-intact, MSI-nonhigh backgrounds, often with SMARCA4-intact or high-quality technical conditioning, several PTEN-loss contrasts clear the threshold, including H62/R98 with validation R106, H80/R54, H97/R68 with validation R79, H110/R108 with validation R118, H149/R151, H162/R164, and H182/R184 signed +0.282 CI +0.157 to +0.407. Therefore PTEN loss should be reported as context-dependent in this dataset, not as a uniform predictor. Negative or nonmeaningful findings: the constructed binary markers D, E, and F are not scientifically meaningful predictors H1/R1, H2/R2 with validation R80, H3/R3, and their constructed signature interactions H4-H6 are null. Most other measured drivers do not provide robust threshold-clear claimed associations, including KRAS, STK11, MTAP, ARID1A, RB1, NF1, SMAD4, MYC amplification, EGFR amplification, BRAF V600E, ERBB2 amplification, PIK3CA mutation, BRCA2 loss, and APC mutation. Unresolved uncertainty: the exact boundary conditions for PTEN loss, possible small CDKN2A effects, and several QC-conditioned or small-cell stratified contrasts remain uncertain. These unresolved items do not overturn the four central findings because those central effects are large, validated within the supplied dataset, and stable across multiple measured strata. Causality and generalizability: all conclusions are descriptive associations in the supplied observational dataset. The endpoint is a composite dependency score, not a single-gene knockout measurement; predictors may be correlated, eligibility and QC restrictions can induce selection or collider issues, and independent validation inside the supplied data does not establish causality, mechanistic single-gene essentiality, clinical transportability, or external generalizability. Most informative next analysis: pre-specified external replication of SMARCA4 loss versus intact, MSI-high versus MSI-nonhigh, TP53 loss versus intact, KEAP1 loss versus intact, and PTEN loss versus intact in TP53-intact/MSI-nonhigh backgrounds; preferably with multivariable adjustment for lineage, mutation burden or ploidy, screen quality, Cas9 activity, and QC completeness, plus orthogonal dependency endpoints. Iteration 18/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

expectation

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,

record.narrative: All 12 newly delivered discovery contrasts are signed to their registered directions, and every comparison cell satisfies the minimum 20-observation requirement. For direction -1 claims, a positive signed estimate indicates stronger dependency in the exposed group; for direction +1 claims, it indicates weaker dependency. In the largest screen batch (batch_a), the central predictors remain strongly associated in the same directions as the accepted overall pattern: SMARCA4 loss stronger dependency (H193/R195 +0.862; 95% CI +0.737 to +0.988), KEAP1 loss weaker dependency (H194/R196 +0.733; +0.595 to +0.871), TP53 loss weaker dependency (H195/R197 +0.456; +0.271 to +0.640), and MSI-high stronger dependency (H196/R198 +0.805; +0.578 to +1.032). All point estimates exceed the 0.15-unit threshold with intervals comfortably supporting the claimed direction, so I accept and close these batch-robustness contrasts. In the Ky CRISPR library subset, SMARCA4 loss (H197/R199 +0.830; +0.705 to +0.956), KEAP1 loss (H198/R200 +0.942; +0.806 to +1.078), and MSI-high (H200/R202 +0.981; +0.757 to +1.206) remain threshold-clear and are accepted. However, TP53 loss in the Ky subset (H199/R201) has a positive signed estimate (+0.226) but a 95% CI from +0.016 to +0.436, which is compatible with effects below the 0.15-unit scientific threshold. This is notably attenuated relative to the accepted global TP53 association and is not precise enough to conclude a scientifically meaningful threshold-clear effect. I therefore leave it unresolved but deferred rather than reject it, because the evidence supports the direction but not the threshold with confidence; it may reflect a library-context attenuation, chance, or limited precision. In low-ploidy MSI-nonhigh samples, SMARCA4 loss (H201/R203 +0.794; +0.661 to +0.926), KEAP1 loss (H202/R204 +0.839; +0.718 to +0.960), and TP53 loss (H203/R205 +0.380; +0.195 to +0.564) all clear the threshold and are accepted, reducing concern that the central loss-marker associations are driven only by highly aneuploid or MSI-high backgrounds. Finally, MSI-high association remains strong among samples lacking complete integrated RNA/DNA/CRISPR QC (H204/R206 +0.802; +0.541 to +1.062), and is accepted. These are pre-specified robustness contrasts, but the overall multiplicity burden in the full analysis remains substantial; the accepted results are unusually large and consistent, so simple threshold assessment is reasonable, while the single borderline TP53-Ky result is appropriately held unresolved. The subsets are technical or genomic strata, so measured stratification does not prove confounding is absent, and selection/collider effects cannot be ruled out. These conclusions remain dataset-internal associations on a composite dependency endpoint, not causal effects, single-gene essentiality claims, or evidence of external generalizability. Validation budget is exhausted, so no new validation request is made.

Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use

validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

expectation

research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

Iteration 19/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Iteration 19/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response

prompt:
Iteration 19/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative: No new validation evidence or response deadlines are open, and assessments_due is empty. The voluntary validation budget is exhausted, so I request no validation and make no new accept/reject changes. The active claims H45/H46 and H205-H214 still have no attached discovery evidence and remain unresolved pending analysis. The dataset-internal conclusions are stable under the 0.15 composite dependency-unit threshold. Sign convention: for direction -1 claims, a positive signed estimate means stronger dependency in the exposed group; for direction +1 claims, a positive signed estimate means weaker dependency in the exposed group. Supported findings, all dataset-internal associations only: SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger dependency (H9/R9; independent supplied-data validation R26), with a signed point estimate around +0.83 units and lower bound above 0.15; KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency (H14/R11; validation R125); TP53 loss is associated with weaker dependency overall (H13/R7; validation R39); MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency (H79/R52; validation R66). PTEN loss should be reported as context-dependent rather than a global predictor: its global claim remains unresolved (H59/R38 and validation R53) because the lower bounds fall below 0.15, but several restricted controlled-background contrasts clear the threshold (for example H62/R98/R106, H97/R68/R79, H110/R108/R118, H149/R151, H162/R164, and H182/R184), supporting stronger dependency in TP53-intact, MSI-nonhigh and technically controlled contexts. Negative or nonmeaningful findings are broad: constructed markers D, E, and F and their signature interactions are rejected (H1-H6); most measured genomic drivers lack threshold-clear claimed associations, including KRAS, STK11, MTAP, ARID1A, RB1, NF1, SMAD4, MYC amplification, EGFR amplification, BRAF, ERBB2, PIK3CA, BRCA2, and APC; CDKN2A is near or below threshold and is not robust; technical variables such as Avana library, matched omics, media serum percentage, and sex are rejected; and most interaction analyses do not establish meaningful effect modification. Major unresolved uncertainty remains about the global PTEN-loss boundary, possible Ky-library attenuation of the TP53-loss association (H199 and pending H205), and the pending interaction/boundary analyses H45/H46 and H205-H214. The most informative next analysis is to evaluate those pending interaction and boundary claims against the 0.15 threshold and interval precision, especially H205-H213 and H214; if they remain imprecise or fail to clear the threshold, they should be closed as inconclusive. If external follow-up becomes possible, the highest-value next step is replication of the four central associations and PTEN context-dependence using orthogonal dependency endpoints and adjustment for lineage, mutation burden or ploidy, screen quality, Cas9 activity, QC completeness, and library context. All conclusions remain observational dataset-internal associations and do not establish causality, mechanistic single-gene essentiality, clinical transportability, or external generalizability.

prompt:
Iteration 20/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
